shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.ts; git diff -- src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "accumulateUsage|sums token|defined side|both operands|validated by" src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -80'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git status --short'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix usage helper spec trace links" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
